messages:
Hector G: hey folks, i'm hector (backend) starting today. need to validate a payment-gate feature in staging. who do i ask for temporary console/staging flag admin? also curious about how to get a prod-readonly badge later :wave:
Ops-Mina: welcome Hector! i can grant staging flag admin for 48h. prod-readonly requires manager approval + the access-request form. do you also need observability/dashboard access?
Hector G: yes -- grafana + the canary dashboards would be helpful to watch metrics during the smoke test.
Ops-Mina: noted. i'll grant `flags-admin-staging` + `staging-metrics` for 48h. command i run:
```
accessctl grant --user hector.g --roles flags-admin-staging,staging-metrics --ttl 48h --reason "onboarding: payment-gate smoke test"
```
Onboard-Bot: Access request created: user=hector.g scopes=flags-admin-staging,staging-metrics ttl=48h request_id=req_1785004321
Sec-Lin: security note: do not flip prod flags without a change ticket and two approvers. for staging, include expected metric deltas in the ticket and attach screenshots when you flip. do not paste tokens in chat.
Hector G: understood. how do i request the prod-readonly badge when i'm ready?
Ops-Mina: file the access form (https://internal.redwood/access/request), include your manager's signoff and a short justification. Prod-readonly is view-only: Console -> Configs and Activity, no toggles. Should take ~1-2 business days.
Tom P (product): i'm the owner for payment-gate. ping me the experiment spec and i'll sign off for prod-readonly when it's needed for rollout reviews. for staging tests, just notify me here and i can pair if you want someone to watch the first flip.
Hector G: thanks everyone. Ops-Mina — thanks for provisioning, i'll test the toggle in ~30m and post results + screenshots. Tom, i'll DM the spec now. :thumbsup:
